problems: Classification reuses public.london_daily_covers_base exactly (Website / Google Reserve / OpenTable / walk / reception CASE logic and its staff-name regex exclusion), with the 100-day window removed so the YoY week can be read. Its other bucket is split for this report into ota = Thefork Integration + First Table and tp = everything else left in other.

Metric = SUM(covers) by booking-created date (sr_created_at in Europe/London), is_deleted = false, status_simple <> Canceled, seating areas containing bar excluded. The date predicate is a plain sargable range on sr_created_at with both ends bounded, one window per query, and every query returned first time with no timeout.

Validation: 5 - 11 Oct recomputed on this basis = 11,185 covers against 11,502 published last week (-2.8%), with every venue at or slightly below last week c: Aqua Shard 3,647 to 3,569, Hutong 2,722 to 2,618, Regent St 944 to 910, Azzurra 738 to 722, Shiro Sushi 638 to 603, DSL 2,813 to 2,763. Same -2.8% settling as last week.

Trend last value (W37 = 12,612) verified equal to the sum of cur covers across all six venue rows; trend ot last value (1,250) verified equal to the sum of cur ot. W30 to W36 were re-pulled live from the same week-bucketed query.

Bulk-import rule applied mechanically: any booking whose service date falls before the Monday of the week it was created in is dropped. ZERO rows matched in the London reporting week, so nothing was excluded. A separate check for single-hour clusters of 60 covers or more from a non-staff source also returned nothing.

NO EXCLUSIVE HIRE in the reporting week at Aqua Shard: service-date dinner covers run 149 to 353 on all seven days and the largest staff-named booking in the week is 26 covers. THE MATCHED 2025 WEEK LOST TWO DAYS: Mon 13 and Tue 14 Oct 2025 were both whole-day hires, dinner exactly 0 with 200-cover staff bookings, public covers 146 and 144. On the created-date basis this report uses the effect is small, but any Aqua Shard service-date comparison must strip Monday and Tuesday from both years.

DSL has no 2025 comparison at all. The only reservation created at Dim Sum Library in 13 - 19 Oct 2025 is a single cancelled 5-cover booking, so every DSL y value is a true zero (closed for the rebrand), not a fetch failure. Portfolio covers read +70.6% YoY because of it; ex DSL the figure is +28.0%.
Shiro Sushi recep is 0 in all three windows and Azzurra tp is 0 in all three: true zeros, not fetch failures.
